correctness.rationale: For crown Cr_n, mixed two-independence faces admit at most two vertices per layer; the neighbor counts force the occupied index sets to coincide in the 2+2 case or share indices in 2+1, so every mixed face lies in tetrahedron T_ij={a_i,a_j,b_i,b_j}; hence X=Delta_A union Delta_B union L, L=union T_ij. Each b_i is dominated by a_i within L, so L strongly collapses to the complete-graph one-skeleton E_A; symmetrically L->E_B. Attaching the two contractible row simplices along E_A,E_B identifies X homotopically with Sigma E_B, a wedge of choose(n-1,2) copies S². Relative integral H2(X,L)≈V⊕V with connecting map (u,v)->u+v; its kernel is anti-diagonal V and layer-swap acts as -1. The boundary map wedge² Z^n -> I_n, e_i wedge e_j -> e_j-e_i, has kernel wedge² I_n as a free integral lattice using split exact Z^n=I_n⊕Z. The exterior-square trace identity yields the exact S_n×C_2 character. Independently enumerated direct-vs-predicted face masks for n=2..5 match 15,38,76,137; other computer proof channels were not upgraded from mod-2 to integral.
